facts.name: Erin Daly
facts.assignment: Circuit civil, guardianship, mental health including risk protection, and drug court under S-2025-58-A effective June29,2026. Profile also lists problem-solving courts.

contact.contact_note: Assistant/office shared telephone; personal judicial email not established.

hearing_scheduling.summary: Use subject-specific OnceHub route for up to one hour after filing motion, conferring and coordinating three available choices. Wait for approval before notice; include motion docket number. Longer hearings go to assistant copying all parties. Cross-noticing requires express authorization; motion-practice order limits routine oral hearings.

motions.summary: File motions and supporting memoranda with clerk; standing order ordinarily resolves motions on papers unless hearing required or granted. Written oral-argument requests accompany motion/opposition and estimate time; see official order for exceptions and details.

conferral.summary: Standing order requires good-faith telephone, video or in-person conferral before motions and management/pretrial conferences; email alone should not suffice. Hearing dates must also be coordinated.

proposed_orders.summary: After supporting filings are docketed, upload separate Word proposed orders to Judiciary through e-Portal, with required case/service fields. File case-management plan with clerk separately from proposed approval order. Use official template and check rejection notices.

courtesy_copies.summary: Profile civil/evidence sections specify five days for evidence delivery; Zoom section and linked Zoom order specify48hours. Preserve both; no controlling lead time determined. Send separate identified exhibits to assistant and opposing parties; profile permits physical delivery.

remote_appearances.summary: Trials/evidentiary hearings ordinarily in person in Courtroom B. For Zoom request, file motion, email courtesy copy to assistant and upload proposed order at least five business days ahead; leave link space. Short non-evidentiary settings may use Zoom, subject to court approval.

chambers_communications.summary: Copy parties on scheduling email; allow two business days for booking response. No direct merits communication to judge.

cancellations.summary: Email assistant with reason and obtain approval before filing cancellation notice. Court-set hearings require stated dismissal/order route; agreement alone does not grant continuance.

facts.summary: Coordinated OnceHub scheduling, paper-based motion practice and portal Word orders; retain different evidence-delivery statements and dated AI provisions without resolving their relationship.

review_scope.collected: Complete profile, seven-page DACMS/motion-practice order, one-page scheduling instructions, two-page Zoom order; reused assignment PDF.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Contacts and concise recurring civil scheduling/conferral/submission/appearance rules; order header, service notice, AI statement and cited routing sections; scheduling and Zoom texts.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Detailed litigation deadlines, discovery recipes, foreclosure checklist, medical examination guidelines, calendars and drug/veterans court materials. Links retained; shared AI order applicability remains county review.

conflicts.subject: Evidence delivery lead time
statements: Profile civil/evidence sections: five days before hearing.
Profile Zoom section and March26,2025 Zoom order:48hours.
conflicts.disposition: Both preserved; no determination of control.

conflicts.subject: Proposed-order template instructions
statements: Profile directs preserving codes in case-management approval form and requires correct codes.
General order-format section prohibits Word field codes and requires plain text.
conflicts.disposition: Source-specific wording preserved; no template rewrite or resolution.

conflicts.subject: Dated AI directions
statements: January7,2025-effective motion-practice order section5 requires facial notation of generative AI use.
Profile separately links amended A-2026-13-A; existing Fifth Circuit shared evidence records different disclosure language.
conflicts.disposition: Older statement preserved; exact amended-source reuse and reconciliation remain shared county review, not authority resolution.

gaps: No personal judicial email or distinct assistant-only phone established.
